info.description: API for managing roles, courses, teachers, students, course offerings and attendance.
info.title: Course Attendance Management API

get.description: Returns paginated courses, newest first. Set isDeleted=true to include soft-deleted courses.

post.description: Creates a course owned by the authenticated admin.

get.description: Returns a single course by ID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a course. Fails with 409 if the course has any offerings. Use the restore endpoint to undo.

patch.description: Updates a course's title, description and/or code. Empty fields are left unchanged.
Clears the soft-delete timestamp of a course.

get.description: Returns the students enrolled in any offering of the course. A student enrolled in several batches appears once.
Returns the teachers who created the course, are assigned to it, or instruct one of its offerings.
Returns system-wide totals for teachers, students, courses, offerings, enrollments and attendance.
Returns all roles, newest first.
Returns a single role by ID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a role. Fails with 409 while any user still has the role. Use the restore endpoint to undo.

patch.description: Updates a role's name and/or description. Empty fields are left unchanged.
Clears the soft-delete timestamp of a role.

get.description: Returns paginated students (role_id 3). Set isDeleted=true to list only soft-deleted students.

post.description: Creates a user with role_id 3. The password is hashed with bcrypt.

get.description: Returns a single student by ID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a student. Use the restore endpoint to undo.

patch.description: Updates a student's first and/or last name. The role cannot be changed through this endpoint.

get.description: Returns the course offerings (with course and instructor info) that a given student is enrolled in. Admin only.

delete.description: Removes the supplied course offering IDs from the student's enrollments. The offerings and courses are not deleted.
delete.summary: Unenroll a student from course offerings

patch.description: Adds the supplied course offering IDs to the student's enrollments. Existing enrollments are kept. Use the DELETE endpoint to remove offerings.
patch.summary: Enroll a student in course offerings

patch.description: Clears the soft-delete timestamp of a student.

get.description: Returns paginated teachers (role_id 2), newest first. Set isDeleted=true to include soft-deleted teachers.

post.description: Creates a user with the given role_id. The password is hashed with bcrypt.

get.description: Returns a single teacher (role_id 2) by ID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a teacher. Use the restore endpoint to undo.

patch.description: Updates a teacher's names and/or role. Empty names are left unchanged; roleId must be 1–3 to take effect.

delete.description: Removes the given courses from the teacher's assignments. The courses themselves are not deleted. Fails with 404 if any course does not exist.

patch.description: Replaces the teacher's assigned courses with the given list. Duplicate IDs are ignored. Fails with 404 if any course does not exist.
Clears the soft-delete timestamp of a teacher.

post.description: Sets a new password for the authenticated user. oldPassword must match the current password and newPassword must match confirmPassword.
Exchanges email and password for an access token and a refresh token. The access token expires after 30 minutes and the refresh token after 5 hours.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile and role.

post.description: Issues a new access and refresh token pair from a valid refresh token. The old refresh token is replaced.
Creates a user with the given role. No authentication is required.

get.description: Returns the authenticated student's attendance for each offering they are enrolled in, including per-session records and an attendance percentage over the sessions that were marked.
Downloads the authenticated student's full attendance history as a CSV file.
Returns totals for the authenticated student's enrollments, upcoming sessions and attendance.
Returns the course offerings the authenticated student is enrolled in, newest first.

post.description: Adds the authenticated student to the given offerings. Existing enrollments are kept.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated student's enrollment in an offering. The offering and any attendance already recorded are kept.

get.description: Returns every active course offering with its course and instructor, newest first. Use the enrollments endpoint to enroll.
Returns the courses the authenticated teacher created or is assigned to, newest first.

post.description: Creates a course owned by the authenticated teacher.

get.description: Returns a course the authenticated teacher created or is assigned to.

post.description: Schedules a batch of one of the teacher's courses. The authenticated teacher becomes the instructor. Students enroll in offerings, not courses.

get.description: Returns totals for the authenticated teacher's courses, offerings, enrolled students, sessions and attendance.
Returns the course offerings the authenticated teacher instructs, newest first.
Returns the class sessions of one of the teacher's offerings, in chronological order.

post.description: Adds a class session to one of the teacher's offerings.

get.description: Returns the students enrolled in an offering the authenticated teacher instructs.
get.summary: List students enrolled in my offering

get.description: Returns every student enrolled in the session's offering with their attendance status. Present is null if not yet marked.

put.description: Sets present or absent for enrolled students in a session the teacher instructs. Re-marking a student overwrites their status. Students not in the list are left unchanged.

get.description: Downloads a CSV of every student enrolled across the authenticated teacher's course offerings.

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL

BearerAuth.description: Enter "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token returned by POST /api/login.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

tags.description: Login, registration, token refresh and profile
tags.name: auth

tags.description: Teacher-scoped course, offering and enrollment views
tags.name: teacher

tags.description: Student-scoped course catalogue, enrollment and attendance
tags.name: student
